records.subject: Crisis contacts: one source of truth vs deliberate redundancy

readings.value: One config file every surface reads (VetBuddy config/crisis_floor.yaml)
Four independent copies so a dead API or DB still shows a hotline (Women Veterans module)

records.resolution: One authored source; generated copies. The API reads config/crisis_floor.yaml, the standalone app embeds a generated copy (web/kernel_data.js), and a test fails if any copy drifts. Redundant delivery, single authorship.
